items.source: Supports a graceful shutdown through SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor.setTaskTerminationTimeout(long), at the expense of task tracking overhead per execution thread at runtime. Supports limiting concurrent threads through SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor.setConcurrencyLimit(int). By default, the number of concurrent task executions is unlimited. This allows for dynamic concurrency of scheduled task executions, in contrast to ThreadPoolTaskScheduler which requires a fixed pool size.
items.translation: 支持通过SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor.setTaskTerminationTimeout(long)实现优雅关闭，但会牺牲运行时每个执行线程的任务跟踪开销。 支持通过SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor.setConcurrencyLimit(int)限制并发线程数。 默认情况下，并发任务执行次数没有限制。 这使得调度任务执行能够动态调整并发度，与需要固定池大小的ThreadPoolTaskScheduler形成对比。

items.source: Extends SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor and can serve as a fully capable replacement for it, for example, as a single shared instance serving as a TaskExecutor as well as a TaskScheduler. This is generally not the case with other executor/scheduler implementations which tend to have specific constraints for the scheduler thread pool, requiring a separate thread pool for general executor purposes in practice.
items.translation: 扩展了 SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor，并可作为其完全功能的替代方案，例如作为一个单一的共享实例，同时充当 TaskExecutor 和 TaskScheduler。其他执行器/调度器实现通常并非如此，它们往往对调度线程池有特定限制，在实践中需要为通用执行器目的使用单独的线程池。

items.source: As an alternative to the built-in thread-per-task capability, this scheduler can also be configured with a separate target executor for scheduled task execution through setTargetTaskExecutor(Executor): for example, pointing to a shared ThreadPoolTaskExecutor bean. This is still rather different from a ThreadPoolTaskScheduler setup since it always uses a single scheduler thread while dynamically dispatching to the target thread pool which may have a dynamic core/max pool size range, participating in a shared concurrency limit.
items.translation: 作为内置的每个任务一个线程功能的替代方案，此调度器也可以通过 setTargetTaskExecutor(Executor) 配置为使用单独的目标执行器来执行计划的任务：例如，指向共享的 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor Bean。这仍然与 ThreadPoolTaskScheduler 的设置有很大不同，因为它始终使用单个调度器线程，同时动态地将任务分发到目标线程池，该线程池可能具有动态的核心/最大线程池大小范围，并参与共享的并发限制。

items.source: NOTE: This scheduler variant does not track the actual completion of tasks but rather just the hand-off to an execution thread. As a consequence, a ScheduledFuture handle (for example, from schedule(Runnable, Instant)) represents that hand-off rather than the actual completion of the provided task (or series of repeated tasks). Also, this scheduler participates in lifecycle management to a limited degree only, stopping trigger firing and fixed-delay task execution but not stopping the execution of handed-off tasks.
items.translation: 注意：此调度器变体不跟踪任务的实际完成，而仅跟踪向执行线程的移交。 因此，ScheduledFuture 句柄（例如来自 schedule(Runnable, Instant)）代表的是该移交，而非所提供任务（或一系列重复任务）的实际完成。此外，此调度器仅有限地参与生命周期管理，它会停止触发器的触发和固定延迟任务的执行，但不会停止已移交任务的执行。

items.source: NOTE: This implementation does not reuse threads! Consider a thread-pooling TaskScheduler implementation instead, in particular for scheduling a large number of short-lived tasks. Alternatively, on JDK 21, consider setting SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor.setVirtualThreads(boolean) to true.
items.translation: 注意：此实现不会重用线程！ 对于调度大量短生命周期任务的情况，请考虑使用线程池的 TaskScheduler 实现。或者，在 JDK 21 上，请将SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor.setVirtualThreads(boolean)设置为true。

items.source: If not set, the regular SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor arrangements kicks in with a new thread per task.
items.translation: 如果未设置，则启用默认的SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor机制，为每个任务创建新线程。

items.source: As of 6.1, this method comes with a default implementation that delegates to TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable).
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，此方法具有默认实现，该实现委托给 TaskExecutor.execute(Runnable)。

items.source: NOTE: Scheduling with a fixed delay enforces execution on a single scheduler thread, in order to provide traditional fixed-delay semantics! Prefer the use of fixed rates or cron triggers instead which are a better fit with this thread-per-task scheduler variant.
items.translation: 注意：使用固定延迟调度会强制在单个调度器线程上执行，以提供传统的固定延迟语义！ 请改用固定速率或 Cron 触发器，它们更适合这种每个任务一个线程的调度器变体。

items.source: The LifecycleProcessor will call only this variant of the stop method; i.e. Lifecycle.stop() will not be called for SmartLifecycle implementations unless explicitly delegated to within the implementation of this method.
items.translation: `LifecycleProcessor` 将仅调用此版本的 `stop` 方法；即，除非在该方法的实现中显式委托，否则不会为 `SmartLifecycle` 实现调用 `Lifecycle.stop()`。

items.source: The provided callback is used by the LifecycleProcessor to support an ordered, and potentially concurrent, shutdown of all components having a common shutdown order value. The callback must be executed after the SmartLifecycle component does indeed stop.
items.translation: 提供的回调由LifecycleProcessor使用，以支持具有公共关闭顺序值的所有组件的有序且可能并发的关闭。该回调必须在SmartLifecycle 组件确实停止后执行。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to Lifecycle.stop() and immediately triggers the given callback in the calling thread. Note that there is no synchronization between the two, so custom implementations may at least want to put the same steps within their common lifecycle monitor (if any).
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给 Lifecycle.stop()，并立即在调用线程中触发给定的回调。请注意，这两者之间没有同步机制，因此自定义实现至少希望将相同的步骤放在其公共生命周期监视器（如果有）内。

items.source: In the case of a container, this will return true only if all components that apply are currently running.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，仅当所有适用的组件当前都在运行时，此方法才返回 `true`。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: The default clock is the system clock for the default time zone.
items.translation: 默认时钟是默认时区的系统时钟。
